Kai Morgan: hey folks, first day here! quick: if I hit a credentials/access error when trying to push a model to Dedicated or need an urgent infra assist, what's the fast path? also who approves Dedicated quotas?

Priya Desai: hey kai, welcome! :wave: Short flow: 
- For creds/perms: submit the access request form (link below) and tag me or @olivia. usually I can sponsor tenancy joins.
- For Dedicated quota bumps or pool creation: file a ticket in platform-ops with "dedicated-quota" label and @tom will triage.

Tom Hsu: yup. For Dedicated owners: eng-platform owns pool provisioning and quota. If it's blocking a release, include "blocker" in the ticket title and ping #eng-platform. Typical ticket body we need: team, model name, expected steady qps, peak qps, target p99 latency, retention (minutes). Example minimal: ```team: search-service; model: rdx-4b; steady_qps: 10; peak_qps: 30; p99_ms: 150```

Olivia Park: for production incidents: post in #eng-oncall first. The bot will surface on-call and PagerDuty. If customer-facing degradation, escalate immediately (use !pager or call the PD number). For non-urgent infra requests we handle within 48 hours.

Kai Morgan: thanks! two more: who is the data access/secure-keys owner for private deployments? and where do I find the org chart for who owns each surface?

Priya Desai: data keys/KMS for Private deployments are managed by Security & Compliance. Ping @security-eng or file a support ticket labeled "kms-request". Org chart and ownership list live in the handbook: https://redwood.internal/handbook/org/ownership (search "ownership matrix"). If you want, I can DM a short PDF with the oncall rotations.

eng-oncall-bot: Current on-call: Tom Hsu (week 1893410000). To trigger on-call escalation use `!pager` in #eng-oncall or call PagerDuty. Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra-dedicated

Kai Morgan: perfect, I'll submit the form now. Appreciate the quick answers!
